Aazadi hathiyaron se nahi, logon se milti hai.
Aazad hone ka aatm-sar doosron ke liye khud ko zanjeeron mein bandhna hai.
Joy rooh ki shukraguzari ki prarthana hai.
Joy andar bhagwan ki awaaz hai.
Khushi ka raaz aazadi hai... aur aazadi ka raaz, himmat hai.
Khushi hi ekmatra bhala hai.
Sabse khush log woh lagte hain jinke paas khush hone ka koi khas karan nahi hota sivaaye iske ki woh hain.
Khushi divya shakti ki shaant maujoodgi hai.
Khushi unchi hai.
Khushi umeed ki meethi awaaz hai.
Zyadatar log utne hi khush hote hain jitna woh apna dimaag bana lete hain.
Khushi Bhagwan ki maujoodgi ka pakka saboot hai.
Khushi astitva ka aanand hai.
Joy gahri jagrukta ka phal hai.
Azaadi apne vichar vyakt karne ka adhikar hai.
Joy sadgi ki gehraiyon mein milti hai.
Khushi doosre shehar mein ek bada, pyar karne wala, care karne wala parivar hona hai.
Khushi oonchi hai.
Khushi ka saar hi khushi hai.
Azaadi himmat par adharit ek system hai.
Khushi choti choti cheezon ki sarahana karne ki kala hai.
Pahad pure joy ke raaz fusfusate hain.
Azadi jagah hai.
Azadi har jagah hai.
